scenes.narration: Electric cars are no longer a novelty
With many models offering over 300 miles on a single charge
The Hyundai Ioniq 5 is a prime example
Its 77.4 kWh battery provides an estimated 303 miles of range
Making electric vehicles a viable option for many drivers
